plan_review.notes: Adversarial plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.6-terra; separate model from the Opus implementer). Verdict: the initial 'replace only the force-push' plan was UNSOUND. Enumerated 4 alternatives (one-PR-per-cycle FIFO; atomic force-push then flip semantics; git-ancestry-only attestation; staging integration branch) and 7 blocking findings, ALL folded into the shipped design: (1) merge API has no base-CAS -> pre-merge main==expectedParent assertion + auto-merge fencing + queue:max; (2) intermediate prefixes unvalidated -> escalated to the human, who chose prefix-validated Option B (validate every prefix before promotion, DEC-011); (3) post-commit mismatch=containment -> fail-closed postcondition check on the actual landed commit; (4) no crash recovery -> real merged-state is the durable journal + reconcileLandedSignals; (5) legacy auto-merge race -> disableAutoMerge + fail-closed; (6) bypass unproven for behind PRs -> required 2-PR canary documented; (7) downstream unsafe -> trailer-first resolver + preview state==open fix. plan_divergence=major_fork: the design fundamentally changed from a promotion swap to a hardened prefix-validated redesign with an ADR amendment.

rounds.notes: Round 1 on the initial squash-merge promotion. Gemini: createMergePullRequest threw for hard failures, bypassing the caller's fail-closed postcondition publish (fixed: returns {ok:false,retryable:false}). GPT: (High) unvalidated prefixes promoted -> resolved by the human-chosen prefix-validation design (planPrefixPromotion + verifyPrefixEvidence); (High) reconcileLandedSignals backfilled any merged PR without provenance -> now requires base==main + Merge-Train-PR trailer + linearity; (Med) landed comment cited finalCandidateSha -> now candidateShas[index]; (Med) resolve-landed-pr trusted arbitrary trailer lines -> now corroborates merge_commit_sha===sha; (Med) backfill mutated before precondition -> now verifies closed+unmerged + commit/trailer provenance first.

Round 2 confirmed the prefix-validation gate, parent-chaining/indexing, reconcileLandedSignals provenance, resolver, and backfill preconditions CLEAN, and surfaced 4 more, all fixed: (Gemini Critical) landedCommitProofError read main/PR immediately after PUT with no retry -> now polls the eventually-consistent reads through GitHub read-replica lag before failing; (GPT High) ambiguous PUT failure that actually merged skipped the proof -> createMergePullRequest re-reads the PR and returns the real merge SHA so the full proof runs; (GPT Med) mergeability-poll GET could throw past the fail-closed contract -> wrapped as retryable; (GPT Med) backfill accepted an unvalidated SHA -> requires commit existence + matching trailer. Every fix has deterministic test coverage (143 merge-train unit tests). Proceeding under the 2-round cap with all findings resolved (no unresolved disagreement).

Two independent models reviewed the same diff in parallel; adjudicated by the Opus implementer. Distinct findings (no material disagreement): Gemini flagged the throw-bypass; GPT flagged the unvalidated-prefix promotion (High) plus 4 provenance/accuracy issues. All accepted and fixed except GPT's workflow-execution facet, which was adjudicated as inherent to real-merge semantics (documented ADR 0063 RSK-003, human-accepted).

Re-review of the prefix-validation delta + round-1 fixes. Both models confirmed the core gate/proof/provenance clean; adjudicator accepted and fixed all 4 remaining findings (proof read-replica polling, ambiguous-merge disambiguation, poll-GET wrap, backfill SHA provenance), each with deterministic tests. No unresolved cross-model disagreement; adjudication converged.
